Order No.06 Date: 06.01.2025
1.

The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the concerned respondent to make payment of compensation to the petitioners for their land appertaining to different plots of Khata No.5, Mouza- Bhikhan Modi vs The State Of Jharkhand Through Chief ... on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127227541/
2 Bangrakala, Thana No.21, Circle-Birni, District-Giridih measuring total area of 0.5162 acre concerning L.A. Case No.6 of 2018-19 acquired for strengthening of road from 'Beko' to 'Makhmargo' vide notification as contained in memo no.1468 dated 8th November, 2018 issued by the respondent no.3 under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30/2013).

2. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of respondent nos.6 to 8 sworn by Assistant Engineer,
Road Division, Koderma.
It has been stated in paragraph no.11 of the said counter affidavit that an amount of Rs.5,55,50,432/-
has already

been transferred by Road Division, Koderma on the payee ID provided by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Giridih for payment of the same to the concerned beneficiaries (the persons whose lands have been acquired).

3. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that Road Division,
Koderma has already transferred the aforesaid amount to respondent no.4-District Land Acquisition Officer, Giridih, the petitioners are given liberty to prefer a fresh representation seeking payment of compensation before the respondent no.4.

On receipt of the said representation, the respondent no.4 after verifying the relevant records and on providing due opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and other concerned persons shall take an appropriate informed decision in accordance with law within two months from the date of filing of the same.

4. If the respondent no.4 finds that the aforesaid land of the petitioners has been acquired for strengthening of the road in question, due compensation shall be paid to them within two months thereafter.
5. The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of with the aforesaid liberty and direction.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Arpit/
